integrity: Analytic proof and standalone finite verification supplied; no independent validation or external certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Applies to parallel homothetic frusta of full-dimensional convex bases, not skew prismatoids. The dimension-uniform logistic limit is relative to the base-dependent prism quotient, with fixed compact transition parameter. The sharp upper endpoint invokes established 2026 Godbersen and equality results; historic priority for the new section reduction and shape-uniform transition is provisional.
title: Shape-uniform logistic crossover for difference bodies of homothetic frusta
